# Alexander Tibbets

> Note: A concise index summary is available in [llm.txt](/llm.txt).

My name is Alexander Tibbets.
I like to build things, tell stories, and help people.
IFTTT (https://ifttt.com) is an app I co-founded that lets you connect all the things in your life, on your terms.
Today I help startups launch, pivot, and grow their business. Especially within media technology and developer tools.
Feel free to reach out (mailto:alexander.tibbets@gmail.com?subject=👋%20Let's%20connect%20and%20talk%20shop) if you'd like to connect and share ideas.
